meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: Scripted interleavings of all four methods on a single instance. Float and normal results are bits strings; nextInt results are JSON integers; nextBool results are 1/0.
notes: This is the vector that catches stream-position bugs. Each method individually can be correct while the interleaving is wrong.
`spareProbe` walks the nextNormal spare cache explicitly: calls 3 and 6 consume NO PCG output because they return the cached spare.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
